exam.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends one year of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice scalable Spark/single-node/Ray ML, distributed tuning, point-in-time and online/on-demand features, advanced MLflow, deploy-code environments, complete test gates, automated retraining, sliced monitoring/alerts and controlled custom-model rollout.

review.notes: The September 30, 2025 detailed live-version PDF and current three-domain weighted page were reconciled, with current live delivery metadata controlling the PDF discrepancy. Three scenarios, eight labs and 32 original checks cover Spark versus single-node, vertical/horizontal/model/data/trial/group parallelism, Ray and Optuna, nested MLflow/PyFunc, point-in-time/online/on-demand features; deploy-code lifecycle mapping, bundle environments, unit/integration gates, governed automated retraining, snapshot/time-series/inference monitoring, drift/slices/custom metrics/endpoint health and alerts; plus blue-green/canary/shadow rollout and custom-model REST/SDK serving. All 17 guide URLs are cataloged: 15 reachable and MLflow Optuna/O'Reilly automation-blocked; none missing or broken. DAB and Lakehouse Monitoring terminology is preserved as published and translated to current product names; vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced.
